messages:
morgan: FYI canary embed-route spike: p95 ~730ms, visible since 424000-12m. Deploybot flagged it.
deploybot: [alert] embed-route-canary p95=730ms (threshold=600ms); trend=up; autorevert=false.
nash: Is this the PR with updated kv-sharding? rolled yesterday evening.
dez: Logs show `kvcache: shard-miss` bursts and a handful of `quantize-fallback` traces. Might be two issues colliding.
morgan: We need quick decision: manual rollback to v3.4.0 or try live rollback of the sharding tweak?
nash: Prefer rollback. Safer to revert to known-good and then iterate.
deploybot: runbook check: manual rollback if p95 > threshold for >10m or customer errors >1%.
ops-oncall-bot: opening tracking ticket TKT-2024-3321. If rollback >20m notify #cust-impact.
dez: Who can trigger? @morgan, @ash, @dez have ops rights. I can execute.
morgan: Ok execute staged rollback for canary only, pin dedicated pools to v3.4.0, update release notes line.
ash: Drafting customer note: "Performance regression observed in embeddings canary; reverting to prior build while we investigate."
deploybot: action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-embed --by=morgan`
morgan: paused.
deploybot: action: `rollout revert --target=canary-embed --to-version=v3.4.0 --staged=4 --operator=dez`
dez: stage 1/4 done, p95 dropped to 380ms. KV hit moving back up.
nash: Nice. pin dedicated pools: `service.pin_version('embeders', 'v3.4.0')` done.
deploybot: update: revert completed for canary-embed.
morgan: Monitoring 15m. Current p95=420ms, kv-hit=90%.
ops-oncall-bot: Incident-lite created: TKT-2024-3321. Postmortem owner assigned: dez.
dez: Postmortem actions: 1) revert sharding PR from canary, 2) add KV cache warmup step in rollout, 3) tighten canary gating on kv-hit. I'll add to backlog and schedule a follow-up.
nash: Release notes updated in `release-notes/drafts/embeds-2024-03.md`. Customer blurb queued.
morgan: Marking release_state=reverted and pinned_version=v3.4.0. Closing unless anything regresses.
deploybot: metadata updated: release_state=reverted, pinned=v3.4.0, ticket=TKT-2024-3321
morgan: Thanks everyone. Will re-open if we see further anomalies. :thumbsup:
summary: Canary p95 regression on embeddings route; manual staged rollback to v3.4.0 executed, dedicated pools pinned, incident ticket opened, release notes and customer blurb prepared, postmortem actions assigned.
